description: NET INDEPENDENCE RECORD, built and held off: a wallet signs one record about how wallets are linked, which a NET service order reads when it shows whether its parties have a known link to one another: affiliation (you declare that your wallet is linked to another) or attestation (a wallet the operator lists as an attester says whether wallets are independent, with evidence). It is a record only: an affiliation adds a link and cannot be taken back here, the other wallet does not sign it, an attestation is the attester's own word and the board does not check it, and with no attester listed, the default, nobody can attest and no order reads confirmed. You name one act: affiliation (wallets: exactly two addresses, one of them the wallet you sign with; basis: one code from a short list of reasons they are linked), or attestation (a listed attester only: the id of ONE order, the ONE party you attest about, the ONE counterparty it is independent of, a source from a short list, a reference to the evidence, and a verdict of confirmed or affiliated). An attestation is for that one party in that one order against that one counterparty and is never reused: it does not count for another order, another party or the same pair the other way round, and an order reads confirmed only when every outside party in it has been attested against every other party in it. An attestation made before this rule, which named wallets and no order, counts for nothing. An affiliation links the two wallets for good: where they hold different roles in an order it reads affiliated, and an acceptor or provider linked to another party in it is refused. Only a confirmation changes how an order reads: an attester's record of affiliation links nobody, and a confirmation by a wallet that is a party to an order does not count for that order. Nothing here proves anyone is independent: a wallet no one has linked is only one with no known link. FREE to sign, no fee, no gas. The programs are built but held off until the operator switches the NET programs on together: until then both acts are refused before you sign, with the same answer whatever the wallet and whatever the body, but for a house wallet, which is named as such. Prepare refuses only what is true for every wallet: a body that breaks the door's rules (an affiliation must name the wallet you sign with), a house wallet, the kill switch, and no order program switched on. What depends on this wallet is answered only when you submit, so prepare never says whether a wallet is a listed attester or already has the pair on record: the door tells a wallet that is not a listed attester so before it consumes the signature (that signature is not consumed), and the cap of twenty declared affiliations for one wallet is refused, and a pair already on record is read back as already recorded, each after the signature is verified, so each spends the signature. Prepare answers the same for every wallet. This moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through these tools. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the acting wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_independence_record within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

actor.description: The 0x… address that signs this record. Address only, never a private key.

basis.description: affiliation: how the two wallets are linked, one code from the list. Never a sentence.

counterparty.description: attestation: the ONE other 0x… address in the same order that the party is independent of. Address only, never a private key.

evidenceRef.description: attestation: a reference to the evidence, a hash, an id or a short path of letters, numbers and . _ : / # - with no spaces and no sentence, at most 200 characters.

orderId.description: attestation: the id of the ONE order (or match offer, or claim) the attestation is for. It counts for that order and no other.

party.description: attestation: the ONE 0x… address you attest about. Address only, never a private key.

source.description: attestation: where the attester's evidence comes from, one code from the list.

verdict.description: attestation: confirmed (no link was found) or affiliated (a link was found; only a confirmation changes how an order reads).

wallets.description: affiliation: exactly two 0x… addresses, yours and the one you are linked to. Addresses only, never a private key. An attestation takes no list of wallets.

name: prepare_net_independence_record
title: Declare that two wallets are linked, or (a listed attester) record whether wallets are independent (step 1 of 2)
